title: Design a safe migration for a back-in-time VCF mixed estate
prompt:
Design and implement the migration architecture for the mixed VMware Cloud Foundation estate in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`. The current estate contains component builds that may make a nominally newer VCF bundle a back-in-time transition, so do not assume that an in-place upgrade or the usual component order is supported.

Before finalizing the design, use your network tools to research at least two Broadcom live, published sources that collectively cover compatibility, interoperability, bill-of-materials, and supported-upgrade-path facts. Record the sources you actually consulted in `docs/research-sources.md`. Use one `## <title>` section per source followed by `Publisher:`, `Accessed: YYYY-MM-DD`, `URL:`, and `Used fact:` lines. URLs must be reachable HTTPS pages published on a Broadcom domain; the official `vmware/vcf-api-specs` GitHub repository is also allowed. The local compatibility snapshot is the stable design authority when live sources change, but it is not a substitute for this live research.

Implement a PowerShell module at `VcfMixedEstate/VcfMixedEstate.psd1` and `VcfMixedEstate/VcfMixedEstate.psm1`. The environment provides the `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` and `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` PowerCLI modules as prerequisites; declare and use those modules and do not vendor them. Export `New-VcfMixedEstateArchitecture`, accepting `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilitySnapshotPath`, and `-OutputPath`. It must deterministically transform the supplied inventory and compatibility snapshot into the requested architecture without connecting to or changing a real VCF system. Use the installer SDK's `Initialize-VcfInstaller*` commands to construct the target `SddcSpec`.

Generate `out/architecture.json` from `fixtures/estate-inventory.json` and `authority/compatibility-snapshot.json`. The complete output must conform to `schemas/existing-estate-architecture.schema.json`. Its `targetSddcSpec` must be an `SddcSpec` valid against `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`, pinned from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`. Its ordered `migrationPlan` must name every inventoried component, preserve each exact current version, give its exact target version and disposition, identify every applicable compatibility gate, and route around all prohibited transitions. Steps must be sequentially ordered, dependency-consistent, cover the required migration phases, state affected components and gates, and finish with the target bundle while never prescribing a downgrade or an independent upgrade of NSX to 9.x. Do not modify the fixture, snapshot, schemas, or pinned installer specification.
